# pcd_dns_zone (Resource)

Manages a DNS zone in PCD's Designate service. Zone operations are asynchronous; applies wait for the zone to reach an `ACTIVE` status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_dns_zone" "example" {
  name        = "example.com."
  email       = "admin@example.com"
  ttl         = 3600
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The zone name — a fully-qualified domain name ending in a dot (e.g. `example.com.`). Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `attributes` (Map of String) Key/value zone attributes (e.g. pool scheduling hints). Changing this forces a new resource.
- `description` (String) A description of the zone.
- `email` (String) The email for the zone's SOA record (required for PRIMARY zones).
- `masters` (List of String) Master nameservers for a SECONDARY zone.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `ttl` (Number) The zone TTL in seconds. Omit to accept the pool default.
- `type` (String) The zone type: PRIMARY (default) or SECONDARY. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The zone ID.
- `pool_id` (String) The pool the zone is scheduled on.
- `project_id` (String) The owning project.
- `serial` (Number) The zone serial number.
- `status` (String) The zone status (e.g. ACTIVE).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_dns_zone.example <id>
```
